Lung adenocarcinoma from TCGA cohort as SelectSim run results

Source: R/data.R
luad_result.Rd

Result of LUAD generated by SelectSim with SelectSim run done at min.freq=10.

Usage

data(luad_result)

Format

A data frame

Value

A data frame containing SelectSim results for the LUAD cohort.

Examples

data(luad_result)
dim(luad_result)
#> [1] 253  22
